inlineLoaderEvaluation.origin: Block 93 (commit fd508d7: feat(auth): implement session initialization gate)
inlineLoaderEvaluation.rationale: Prevents premature evaluation of AccountStatusGate during the asynchronous window while Firebase resolves local session persistence and queries /users/{uid} in Firestore. Without it, authenticated users reload/refresh into a 200-500ms flash of the UNAUTHENTICATED login screen and NO_PROFILE account request form.
inlineLoaderEvaluation.defectResolved: The only defect in commit fd508d7 was the accidental omission of Loader2 from the lucide-react import in src/App.tsx, which triggered ReferenceError: Loader2 is not defined. Importing Loader2 resolves the runtime error while retaining complete session initialization protection.

accountStatusGateEvaluation.role: Dedicated full-screen gateway for unauthenticated visitors (UNAUTHENTICATED) and post-login access governance (NO_PROFILE, PENDING_APPROVAL, REJECTED, SUSPENDED).

architecturalAnalysis.canonicalArchitecture: Two-Stage Gated Authentication Architecture: Stage 1 Session Initialization Gate (App.tsx lines 265-281 evaluating !isAuthReady || (user && isProfileLoading)) protects against session resolution flashes, followed by Stage 2 AccountStatusGate (App.tsx lines 283-302) enforcing server-authoritative account approval and role validation.
